name: Snyder's of Hanover Mini Salted Pretzels / Pretzel Sticks
whyItWorks: Hard-baked pretzels are naturally virtually fat-free and made from easily digested enriched flour. They satisfy the desire for salty crunch without the greasy vegetable oils of potato chips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a handful of mini pretzels or pretzel sticks between meals. Brush off excessive coarse salt crystals if you are on a restricted-sodium medication regimen (e.g., prednisone).
watchOuts: Brush off excess large salt grains if taking systemic steroids like Prednisone to avoid water retention.
